messages:
maria_sales: HelixHealth POC needs SOC 2 report, ISO27001 excerpt, and a pen-test attestation. They also asked: what's the concrete latency delta between hosted vs dedicated (VPC) for 500 RPS? Need this by EOD tomorrow. Any quick blockers?
ben_se: For docs we can share SOC2.pdf (public report) + control_mapping.xlsx + ISO_scope.pdf. Pen-test: we can provide a signed attestation letter. Full pentest report needs NDA + redaction. Claire, can we do attestation today?
claire_security: Yes we can provide the attestation signed by security lead today. Full report: requires NDA + 48h legal review, and the tester's sign-off. Also note: Helix asked for vulnerability CVE list — we can provide a vulnerability snapshot (non-prod) but not customer-specific findings.
dave_legal: NDA template is ready. If they sign our mutual NDA we can share redacted pen-test report under CII terms. Otherwise attestation letter only. NDA turnaround ~24h if they sign immediately.
elsa_devops: Latency delta: on our typical infra 500 RPS, hosted (multi-tenant) tail p95 ~120ms; dedicated VPC (reserved lane) p95 ~45-60ms. Dedicated adds ~25–35% committed cost vs hosted per sustained throughput. For the POC we can spin a reserved pool for 2 weeks with a 1TB egress cap to limit cost.
maria_sales: They also want to upload a 2GB sample trace to reproduce inference flakiness. Preferred upload: presigned S3 (7 days). Please include a redaction checklist.
ben_se: I'll generate presigned link and upload instructions. Quick redaction checklist we use: remove PII, mask PHI, strip API keys/credentials, remove raw KMS payloads. Add example curl PUT command.
claire_security: Important: do NOT include production session tokens or unmasked PHI. We cannot accept password files. If they insist, we need an isolated sftp and a signed DSA.
dave_legal: Also note: Helix's security questionnaire requested our key custody model. We can send KeyCustody_diagram.pdf and KMS_rotation_policy.pdf but not export customer-managed keys.
evidence-bot: Evidence request created: EVID-4521 for HelixHealth POC. Owner: ben_se.
maria_sales: Can someone bundle: SOC2.pdf, control_mapping.xlsx, ISO_scope.pdf, pentest_attestation.pdf, key_docs.zip and a POC_pricing_sheet.pdf? I'll upload to the dataspace and forward to Helix once ready.
elsa_devops: I'll prepare POC_pricing_sheet: two lines: Hosted (on-demand) — per-token + per-RPS pricing; Dedicated — reserved monthly + burst pricing. Include trial offer: 14-day reserved trial, 750k tokens cap, staging IPs and support hours. ETA: 6pm PT.
ben_se: Presigned link created: https://s3.example.com/helix-poc/UPLOAD?X(pretend). Upload path: helix/poc/2026-03-24/trace.zip. Command: curl -X PUT -T trace.zip "${PRESIGNED_URL}"
maria_sales: Thanks — I'll send to Helix with redaction checklist. If NDA comes through we'll follow up with redacted pen-test.
claire_security: :white_check_mark: Attestation PDF done and signed by security lead. Pinging @dave_legal for final note on distribution.
dave_legal: Acknowledged. I'll review the attestation text for any legal flags; none expected.
evidence-bot: EVID-4521 status updated: docs attached (SOC2, ISO excerpt, pentest_attestation)
